scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:backend
scripts._comment:test:backend: The venv interpreter is spelled out deliberately: a bare `python` on PATH resolves to an unrelated environment with no pytest installed, so the previous `python -m pytest` here failed with 'No module named pytest'. Backslashes because npm runs scripts through cmd.exe on Windows, which rejects a leading './'. These root scripts are dev convenience only -- CI runs each workspace directly (see .github/workflows/ci.yml), never this one. See CLAUDE.md > Test Commands.
scripts.docker:test: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --build backend-tests && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --build frontend-tests && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --build mcp-tests
